nodes.title: linkSpans.ts
nodes.body: Terminal plain-text link scanning exposes only two actionable classes: structurally valid HTTP(S) web URLs and file-path candidates. Matching uses strict token boundaries, excludes file URLs and non-web schemes, trims sentence delimiters from the visual range, and remains a lazy visible-row scan with no filesystem IO. A path candidate is not actionable until the origin filesystem proves that the CWD/workspace-resolved target is an existing file.

nodes.title: linkAffordance.ts
nodes.body: Terminal link affordances classify only web URLs and file paths. Unsafe or unsupported OSC-8 URIs never receive pointer affordances; path targets resolve against pane CWD/workspace context before validation.

nodes.title: linkOpenHost.ts
nodes.body: Opening accepts only credential-free HTTP(S) URLs or existing files inside the pane CWD/workspace scope. File proof is origin-bound, timeout-limited, deduplicated, negatively cached, and size-bounded; directories, missing paths, and out-of-scope paths remain inert.

nodes.title: ports.ts
nodes.body: Host ports provide an optional asynchronous, origin-aware file validation capability used only for a hovered path candidate. Validation shares the same request shape and cache as opening, keeping TerminalManager portable and free of filesystem dependencies.

nodes.title: manager.ts
nodes.body: TerminalManager paints link affordance only for validated HTTP(S) links or origin-proven workspace files. Path validation starts only on modifier-hover, ignores stale async results, and reuses bounded probe caches. DOM hover underlines use one CSS-pixel thickness and device-aligned continuous geometry.

nodes.title: hostPorts.ts
nodes.body: Desktop terminal host ports resolve the captured pane origin once and expose the same origin-bound file proof to hover validation and click opening.

nodes.title: linkResolver.ts
nodes.body: Terminal file proof is reusable without opening. It accepts only existing non-directory files within the request CWD/workspace boundary and shares the bounded origin-aware cache used by the final open operation.

nodes.title: main.ts
nodes.body: The Remote terminal host bridge supports non-opening file validation through the connected origin while preserving URL opening in the browser.

nodes.title: MainApp.svelte
nodes.body: Remote file-link validation probes the connected workspace origin, distinguishes files from directories, returns a boolean without navigation, and shares bounded proof results with click opening.

nodes.title: renderer.rs
nodes.body: The native hyperlink pass draws only structurally safe HTTP(S) OSC-8 spans; unsupported schemes and malformed targets retain text but no hyperlink underline.

nodes.title: webgpu.rs
nodes.body: WebGPU hyperlink underlines are one CSS pixel thick and use device-pixel-aligned continuous rectangles. Active wallpaper is viewport-fixed: wallpaper mode disables composited scroll-copy, repairs every repainted row from the global wallpaper coordinate system, and leaves default TUI cells transparent while preserving explicit TUI cell backgrounds.

nodes.title: net.rs
nodes.body: LAN address discovery returns every usable local IPv4 in deterministic reachability priority, preferring conventional physical-LAN ranges over overlay and virtual-network ranges while retaining all candidates for explicit selection and TLS SAN generation.

nodes.title: mdns.rs
nodes.body: During the bounded pairing window, DNS-SD announcements are sent on every discovered LAN IPv4 to the RFC 6762 multicast group. Each announcement carries an SRV target and matching A record for that interface so clients on Ethernet, Wi-Fi, VPN, or overlay interfaces can resolve a reachable endpoint.
